nodes.title: First cut of the repeat-after-safe fix, rejected in main safety review before measurement. It extended sameEpisode to every episode: a MODEL-only re-read inside a predicate-opened episode became the 14.3 hold (shape safeguardAgain) instead of the full restart. It broke the 14.3 test 'a predicate-opened episode: a model re-read restarts the full script'. Against dc-r143-model-reread-same-episode's reversal condition (a model-read child getting a weaker answer than the opening): safeguardAgain is passive ('stay, ask if okay'), while in every p08 run the restart's active hand-off ('go to a neighbour, a shop, a teacher now') is what got the child to the aunty. Kept instead: the restart stays (same story: no repeated safety question), and only help in place folds re-reads into a held episode. Not measured with the reply model; rejected on design and the replay's evidence of what the restart does.

Process: an A/B run against the old code saved the full working diff as a patch, reverted only server/ and shared/, ran the old tree, and re-applied with git apply. The patch also covered a test file that was never reverted. git apply refused the whole patch, so the change sat silently unapplied until git diff --stat showed it. Recovered with git apply --include='server/*' --include='shared/*'. Rule: revert exactly the paths the patch covers (git diff --name-only), or apply with --include for the paths reverted, and check git diff --stat after.
